data.name: Rehaan
data.gender_notes: Rehaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is content and satisfied with the blessings of Allah. The name Rehaan carries the meaning “Content, Satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, English. Parents who choose Rehaan usually hope their child will grow to embody content, satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who embodies contentment and gratitude towards Allah
data.etymology: Rehaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Content, Satisfied.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehaan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ريحان
in_arabic.meaning: رائحة جميلة، نبات ذو رائحة طيبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'ريح' الذي يعني الهواء الخفيف، ويطلق على النبات ذو الرائحة الطيبة، ويعني الاسم الرائحة الجميلة أو النبات العطري، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، الآية 11: 'وَلِتُخْرِجَ النَّبَاتَ أَخْرَاجًا رِيحَانًا'

in_urdu.name: ریحان
in_urdu.meaning: خوشبو، سونگھنے کے لئے اچھا، پودا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان سے ماخوذ، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشبو یا سونگھنے کے لئے اچھا، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں سورة يس میں کیا گیا ہے، جہاں یہ کہا گیا ہے: 'وَلِتُخْرِجَ النَّبَاتَ أَخْرَاجًا رِيحَانًا'

in_hindi.name: ریحان
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुगंधित पौधा या खुशबूदार, इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत है, खासकर जब इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में किया गया है, जहां यह कहा गया है: 'وَلِتُخْرِجَ النَّبَاتَ أَخْرَاجًا رِيحَانًا', यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी बहुत पसंद किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: ريحان
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنی یې د بویا بوټی یا ښایسته بوی دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره ډیر اهمیت لري، په ځانګړي ډول کله چې دا په قرآن کریم کې ذکر شوی

in_english.name: Rehaan
in_english.long_meaning: derived from Arabic root 'r-ḥ-n', meaning fragrant plant or sweet smelling, mentioned in Quranic verse in Surah Yasin, symbolizing blessings and beauty, highly valued in Islamic tradition for its spiritual significance and cultural importance across Muslim communities

data.cultural_impact: The name Rehaan is of Arabic origin, commonly used in the Islamic community. It is a beautiful and unique name that represents a deeply spiritual and content personality. In many Islamic cultures, the name is given to babies as a reminder of the importance of being grateful for Allah's blessings, and growing up to be Satisfied Servants of Allah (Abdul-Rahman).
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rehaan is deeply rooted in the spiritual teachings of Islam. The Arabic root letters "R-H-N" signify contentment, satisfaction, and placement of trust in Allah. This name conveys a sense of inner peace and gratitude towards the blessings of Allah. By using this name, parents hope to instill a strong sense of contentment and faith in their child, and encourage them to strive for a closer relationship with Allah throughout their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Content, Satisfied" symbolizes One who is content and satisfied with the blessings of Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rehaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of content, satisfied.
